title: Neos: Learning to Interleave Search and Visual Reasoning
abstract: arXiv:2610.17043v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Recent multimodal deep search agents have advanced tool use and visual content retrieval, yet they still struggle to convert intermediate visual evidence into actionable guidance for subsequent search, limiting their effectiveness in long-horizon settings. To address this gap, we present Neos, a multimodal deep search framework that learns both how to acquire evidence and how to use it to guide subsequent decisions. To make this coupling learnable, Neos constructs training tasks with intermediate visual dependencies while filtering out textual shortcuts, and introduces a lightweight, trainable Multimodal Evidence Interface (MEI) that transforms retrieved content into goal-conditioned observations. At its core, an agent-environment co-evolution procedure treats MEI as a co-adaptive component of this loop. translated_title: Neos：学习交错进行搜索与视觉推理
translated_abstract: 近期的多模态深度搜索智能体在工具使用和视觉内容检索方面取得了进展，但它们仍然难以将中间视觉证据转化为对后续搜索的可操作指导，这限制了它们在长程任务中的有效性。为了解决这一缺口，我们提出了 Neos，这是一个多模态深度搜索框架，它同时学习如何获取证据以及如何利用证据来指导后续决策。为了使这种耦合具备可学习性，Neos 构建了具有中间视觉依赖关系的训练任务，同时过滤掉文本捷径，并引入了一个轻量级、可训练的多模态证据接口，将检索到的内容转化为以目标为条件的观测。其核心是一种智能体-环境协同进化机制，将 MEI 视为该循环中的一个共同适应组件。具体而言，基于参考引导的信用分配利用经验证的成功轨迹来定位关键的策略错误，同时保留……（原文摘要截断）
tldr: Neos 提出了一个多模态深度搜索框架，通过可训练的多模态证据接口（MEI）与智能体-环境协同进化机制，学会获取中间视觉证据并将其转化为指导后续搜索决策的信息。
en_tdlr: Neos is a multimodal deep search framework that learns both to acquire intermediate visual evidence and to use it for guiding subsequent decisions, via a lightweight trainable Multimodal Evidence Interface (MEI) and an agent-environment co-evolution procedure with reference-guided credit assignment.
